about_the_game: Long shot Is a first person VR experience. Long shot features multiple levels which feature targets that the players shoots with a variety of weapons.  Long Shot also features a separate tower defense mode. The main mode in Long Shot takes place at an out door shooting range where a player can shoot at targets to gain points. Long Shot castle defense is a separate mode where a player shoots at solders who are trying to invade the players island. The player can switch between towers and shoot the solders as they spawn and try to reach the players castle. Both modes are first person. The main weapon for both modes is a crossbow.
